verdict.rationale: smolagents documents pushing an agent to the Hugging Face Hub as a Space repository and loading it back with from_hub, which is a thin path toward hosting it on a managed runtime. The Modal, E2B, Blaxel and Docker integrations only sandbox code execution and are not agent deployment. Missing for 10: documented deployment of an agent to a managed serving runtime, any evidence of calling the deployed agent as an API endpoint (request/response contract, auth, scaling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
